personas.bio: 52, accountant in Perth. Weeknights are for spreadsheets and sleep; Saturday night is one action film with his wife and Sunday afternoon is a western. Rates two films a week, like clockwork.

favorites.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly

anchorRatings.title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid

personas.bio: 74, former piano teacher in Montreal. Stopped going to the cinema when colour got garish. Only rates films made before 1970 and is proud of it.
26, UX designer in Kraków with an unlimited cinema pass. Sees whatever opened this week and has zero interest in anything older than about ten years.
30, kindergarten teacher in Taipei. Picks films by how her day went, not by genre: wrecked days get something cozy, good days get a cry. Never wants anything grim or tense.

anchorRatings.title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty

personas.bio: 45, insurance adjuster in Cork. Will watch anything on a Tuesday and finds most of it 'grand'. Ticked three genres up to 8 only because onboarding made him.
19, marketing student in Atlanta. Watches whatever is all over her feed that week so she can join the group chat, and rates the big hits high.

anchorRatings.title: Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens

personas.bio: 38, record-shop owner in Malmö. If it has a trailer on the side of a bus, he's out. Only rates things nobody he knows has seen, and docks points for anything that got popular.

personas.archetype: Reviewer who writes notes on everything
personas.bio: 33, high-school English teacher in Vancouver. Never rates without leaving a note: what she felt, the score cue she loved, which friend should watch it. Music films get the longest essays.
39, homeschooling mum of four in rural Kansas. The whole family uses her account, so she locked it to PG with every content limit at the floor. Loves a Hallmark-style TV movie and old musicals.
41, translator in Lyon. Takes her holidays around Cannes, Berlin and San Sebastián and rates films months before they open. Subtitles always, dubbing never.
58, school bus driver in Tucson. Has watched the same three films hundreds of times and rarely tries anything new; when she does, it's usually a let-down.

anchorRatings.title: Back to the Future Part II

personas.bio: 34, sports-radio producer in Porto Alegre. Rates the canon low on principle and defends critical flops loudly. Thinks The Godfather is boring and Batman & Robin is misunderstood.
27, dental hygienist in Guadalajara. Just happy to be watching a movie. Her lowest score this year was a 7 and she felt bad about it.
61, retired history teacher in Hamburg. A 7 from him is a rave. War films and courtroom crime are the only things that ever crack an 8, and then only the very best.
36, primary-school librarian in Utrecht. Raising two little goths: every Friday is a spooky-but-kid-safe film, every Saturday after bedtime is real horror for her.
